channel.title: Wire — Node.js
channel.description: Node.js from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: A Deep Dive into JavaScript Engines: Writing Code That Makes V8 Happy
item.description: I’m going to take you deep into the inner workings of V8 so you can understand how best to optimise all the JavaScript code you write day in, day out. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Connection Reuse is the Money
item.description: Our webhook sender spent 24 hours a day on TLS handshakes with one destination. Undici keep-alive skipped almost all of them, our biggest latency win. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: How to Implement a Distributed Circuit Breaker
item.description: The circuit breaker pattern is simple in one process and much harder across a fleet. Shared state, stale results, probe arbitration and coordinator loss, with a working Redis implementation. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: @platformatic/memcached: A Faster memcached Client
item.description: Platformatic's high-performance memcached client for Node.js, with zero dependencies, request pipelining, and over 350,000 SETs per second. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Five Software Engineering Roles for Working with AI
item.description: Software engineers can work with AI in different ways, from observing every change to managing an entire software factory. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Eraser Diagrams: Diagrams as Code, Minus the Layout Engine
item.description: Eraser Diagrams is an AI-native, coordinate-aware diagram format, open-sourced under the MIT license. This post is about why it needs to exist. (1 source: nodeweekly)
